summary.sizing: Disk figures are still being measured.

worktrees.description: Worktrees with no commit for {days} days or whose branch is already merged into the base branch. The main worktree is never listed.
worktrees.noRoot: Choose the repositories folder in the Worktrees tab first.

processes.description: Development processes that may be holding memory. Processes whose working folder no longer exists are marked as orphans.

folders.description: Folders that can be regenerated (node_modules, target, .venv, dist and package-manager caches). Deleting them is permanent.
folders.noRoot: Only the global caches are searched until you choose a repositories folder in the Worktrees tab.
folders.cancelled: The search was cancelled. Showing the previous results.

removeWorktree.message: Remove the worktree at {path} ({size})? The folder will be deleted; the branch is kept.
removeWorktree.liveWarning: {count} process(es) are running inside it and may be interrupted.

terminate.title: Terminate process
terminate.message: Terminate {name} (PID {pid}, {ram} of RAM)? Unsaved work in it will be lost.

deleteFolder.message: Files skip the Recycle Bin and can't be restored. They can be regenerated, but this cannot be undone.
deleteFolder.partial: Deleted {done} of {total} folders ({size} freed) before an error.

reason.link: It is a link or junction, which is never deleted.
reason.drive_root: A drive root can never be deleted.
reason.home: The home folder (or a folder containing it) can never be deleted.
reason.root: The repositories root folder itself can never be deleted.
reason.outside_root: It is outside the repositories folder and is not a known cache.
reason.not_allowlisted: It is not a regenerable folder (node_modules, target, .venv, dist or a known cache).

readOnly: Read-only scan. Nothing is stopped or deleted until you confirm, and nothing runs automatically.

reasonHint.stale: No commits for {days} days or more, so it is probably forgotten.
reasonHint.merged: Its branch is already merged into the base branch, so removing the worktree loses no work.
reasonHint.clean: Nothing is uncommitted: removing it will not discard any local edits.
reasonHint.live_processes: Processes are running inside this folder; removing it may interrupt them.
